reader-a.description: Reads alpha.txt, beta.txt and alpha.txt again, one call at a time.
reader-a.prompt: Use the Read tool three times, one call at a time and never in parallel: first alpha.txt, then beta.txt, then alpha.txt again, all in the current working directory. Then reply with the three contents separated by single spaces and nothing else.

reader-b.description: Reads beta.txt, alpha.txt and beta.txt again, one call at a time.
reader-b.prompt: Use the Read tool three times, one call at a time and never in parallel: first beta.txt, then alpha.txt, then beta.txt again, all in the current working directory. Then reply with the three contents separated by single spaces and nothing else.
